a: Processes isolate memory; threads share address space within a process.
Signals notify processes (SIGTERM, SIGKILL, SIGINT) for control and shutdown.
rwx bits for user/group/other control file access.
systemd units manage service start, restart, and dependencies.
Cron schedules recurring commands; document timezone clearly.
Prefer key-based SSH; disable password auth on servers when possible.
journalctl reads systemd logs for services and the system.
ulimit controls resource limits like open files and processes.
cgroups limit and isolate CPU/memory for containers and processes.
Namespaces isolate process views of network, mounts, PIDs, etc.
